payload.title: Direct convex mutual-information minimization
payload.objective: min I(Lambda;X), X=(a,b), uniform over four setting pairs.
payload.method: CVXPY relative-entropy formulation with normalization, positivity, no-signalling and CHSH>=target constraints; CLARABEL and SCS.
payload.interpretation: MI is convex in the conditional channel for fixed input distribution. At S=4, CLARABEL returned an optimal solution; SCS had an optimal_inaccurate result and a small CHSH shortfall.
payload.important_correction: The lower MI at Tsirelson than the MI of the TV-optimal solution shows that minimizing TV does not minimize mutual information.
